title: XLIST-HATE: A CHECKLIST-BASED FRAMEWORK FOR INTERPRETABLE AND GENERALIZABLE HATE SPEECH DETECTION
reasoning: The xList-Hate framework is explicitly grounded in normative criteria to evaluate the ethical and moral dimensions of hateful content. It specifically benchmarks the detection of speech targeting individuals or groups based on characteristics such as religion (Q1) and involves evaluating concepts like dehumanization and incitement.
